verdict.rationale: GlitchTip does not ship first-party SDKs of its own. Instead it officially documents using Sentry's open-source SDKs and aims for Sentry API compatibility, and community users confirm the Sentry libraries work reliably with it, including newer reporters such as Svelte. That makes SDK-based integration practical, but the SDKs belong to another vendor rather than being GlitchTip's own. Missing for 10: first-party GlitchTip-maintained SDKs, GlitchTip-specific SDK reference docs, and a published OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404).
